name: 雛菜
text: ──円香先輩、この日空いてる～？
trans: ──Hey Madoka-senpai, are you free on this day～?

name: 円香
text: どこ？
trans: When?

name: 円香
text: ……空いてるけど
trans: ......Yes, I am, but

name: 円香
text: それ、なんのイベント？
trans: What kind of event is that?

name: 雛菜
text:
コスメのポップアップイベントなんだけど～
いろんなブランドが参加してるんだって～
trans:
It's an event with cosmetic pop up stores～ Says
here that a bunch of brands will be participating～

name: 円香
text: へえ
trans: Huh.

name: 円香
text:
……それで？
なんかあるんでしょ、誘う理由
trans:
......And, so?
You asking me to go for some reason, I suppose.

name: 雛菜
text:
うん～、あのね～……
昨日SNSで見つけたんだけど～
trans:
Uhm～ You see～
I saw this on my feed yesterday, but～

name: 雛菜
text:
『特定の条件を達成した来場者に
ユアクマコラボコスメプレゼント！』
trans:
『Meet the conditions and score a set of 
YourKuma collaboration cosmetics!』

name: 雛菜
text:
しかも限定色～！
雛菜、これ絶対欲しい～！
trans:
They're limited edition colors too～!
Hinana, super wants this～!

name: 円香
text: ふうん……
trans: Uh huh...

name: 雛菜
text:
色がいくつかあるんだけど
ひとりひとつしかもらえないから～……
trans:
They're giving out a few colors, and each attendee
will only be given one, so～......

name: 円香
text:
誰かしら譲ってくれそうな人を連れて行って
ふたつもらおうってことね
trans:
So you're dragging someone who would be willing to
give you one so that you can get two, I see.

name: 雛菜
text: あは～、うん～！
trans: Aha～, bingo～!

name: 円香
text:
いいけど……
浅倉と小糸には？
trans:
It's fine by me......
What about Asakura and Koito?

name: 雛菜
text: ふたりとも空いてないって～
trans: Both of them said that they're busy～

name: 円香
text: 肝心の条件だけど……
trans: About the conditions, more importantly......

name: 円香
text:
『ユアクマのバウンドコーデを着て
フォトスポットで撮影、写真をSNSで投稿』って……
trans:
It says here, "Take a photo at our photo booth in a
YourKuma-bound outfit post it on your socials』......

name: 雛菜
text: うん～、そうだよ～！
trans: Uhm～, that's all we gotta do～!

name: 雛菜
text:
ユアクマちゃんのバウンドコーデで
ユアクマちゃんと一緒に撮影できるから～
trans:
I'll be able to take a photo with YourKuma wearing a
YourKuma-bound outfit～

name: 雛菜
text: 雛菜、すごく楽しみ～！
trans: Hinana's super looking forward to it～!

name: 円香
text:
バウンドコーデって、普段着で
ユアクマっぽいコーディネートをするってことでしょ？
trans:
A bound outfit, is a set of casual wear, but with
pieces and accessories inspired by the image of
YourKuma, right?

name: 円香
text:
なんとなくそれっぽい色とか柄は
合わせられるかもしれないけど
trans:
I suppose I can wear something that has its colors or
motifs.

name: 円香
text:
それでユアクマのバウンドコーデに見えるかは
正直不明
trans:
But I'm not certain it'd qualify as a YourKuma-bound
outfit.

name: 雛菜
trans: Huh～？

name: 雛菜
text:
でも、もこもこしたカーデとかあったら
ユアクマちゃんっぽくなるよ～
trans:
But you can just wear a fluffy cardigan and it'd  feel
like YourKuma-chan, you know～

name: 円香
text: そんなものない
trans: I have nothing like that.

name: 雛菜
text:
じゃあ雛菜が
ユアクマちゃんっぽい服貸してあげる～！
trans:
Then Hinana can just, lend you some Yourkuma-chan-
looking clothes～!

name: 円香
text:
面倒じゃない？
そこまでするの
trans:
That's way too troublesome, no?
To go that extent.

name: 雛菜
text: 全然～
trans: Not at all～

name: 円香
text: ……じゃあ、私から条件
trans: ......Okay, then here's a condition of my own.

name: 円香
text: ランチは雛菜のおごりで
trans: Lunch will be on Hinana.

name: 雛菜
text: あは～、了解です～
trans: Aha～, sure thing～!

name: 円香
text:
撮影終わったら、ネカフェとかでランチして
ついでに借りた服もそのまま返す
trans:
After we get the photo, we'll have lunch at a net
cafe or somewhere, and I'll return the clothes then
too.

name: 雛菜
text:
へ～
着替えちゃうの～？
trans:
Heeh～
You're gonna change out of it?

name: 円香
text:
荷物になるし
後から返すのも面倒でしょ
trans:
It'll just become baggage, and it's just troublesome
to return it afterward.

name: 雛菜
text: ん～、そっか～
trans: Hm～ I see～

name: 円香
text: 文句ないならオーケーってことで
trans:
If you have no complaints, I'll take that as a "yes",
then.

name: 雛菜
text: はい～！
trans: Okay～!

name: 円香
text:
企業から頂いたやつと……
ヘアメイクさんから勧められて買ったやつ……
trans:
These are what I got from associates....
And these I bought with the recommendations from
the stylist......

name: 円香
text: ……こんなに持ってたんだ
trans: ...Never realized I'd have so many.

name: ヘアメイク
text:
樋口さんの肌質なら
こういう質感のリップが似合うと思う
trans:
I think that this type of lipstick will be a great match
for Higuchi-san's skin.

name: ヘアメイク
text:
……うん！
すごくいい……！
trans:
......Yes!
It looks wonderful......!

name: ヘアメイク
text: 色は結構、こっちの色とか……
trans: As for the color, maybe something like this......

name: 円香
text: ……必要に応じて、適当にするだけ
trans:
......I was doing what was appropriate, just interacting
as required.

name: 円香
text:
それでなんとかなってるんだから
適切な色を勧めてくれたヘアメイクさんに感謝
trans:
And that somehow worked out, so I have only thanks
for the stylist for her color recommendations.

name: 円香
text:
企業から頂いたコスメは、肌質に合うかとか
無難な色かとか分からないのもあって
trans:
As for these cosmetics from associates, I have no
idea if they go well with my skin, or if the colors are
safe choices or not,

name: 円香
text: 持て余してたけど……
trans: So I really don't know what to do with them...

name: 円香
text:
イベントで色々試せるなら
せっかくだから試して、使えるものは使って
trans:
Well, I'll have to try all sorts of cosmetics at the
event, so I might as well take the opportunity to try
them on, then keep whatever is suitable for me,

name: 円香
text: 合わないのは雛菜とかにあげればいいか
trans:
Then give those that don't suit me to Hinana or the
others.

name: 円香
text: 私の色……
trans: My color......
